author: carwow
description:
The all-new Audi RS5 has one BIG secret - and it might not be a good thing!

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Audi RS5! 

While it’s clear to see that this new generation RS has had a makeover from the outside, it’s hiding a secret that you can’t see from the design alone. It’s now a plug-in hybrid, and as a result, the weight has shot up to over 2,300kg! 

In comparison, the BMW M3 that we’ve brought along for this review tips the scales at only 1,790kg - so the RS5 is more than half a tonne heavier! The question is, does the weight really make such a big difference? Let’s take a closer look. 

Even if you’re not a fan of hybrid tech, there’s no denying that the new RS5 looks seriously impressive! Up from there’s a huge, aggressive-looking wide grille, and a whole load of vents that all serve a purpose. Along the side the widened wheel arches give the car more presence on the road, as do the side skirts
title: New Audi RS5: has Audi ruined it?
